# Find clubs with no associated players
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH player_clubs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT club_id FROM players WHERE club_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.club_name AS club_name
FROM clubs c
LEFT JOIN player_clubs pc ON pc.club_id = c.club_id
WHERE pc.club_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.club_name
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql)
